title: Memory Management
subtitle: Manage long-term memories, preferences, and facts stored by your AI.

empty.title: No memories yet
empty.description: As you interact with AI, it will automatically extract and remember facts about you.

clearAll.title: Clear all memories?
clearAll.description: This action is irreversible. AI will forget all personalized facts about you.

delete.title: Delete this memory?
delete.description: AI will no longer remember this information after deletion.

rollback.title: Rollback to this snapshot?
rollback.description: This will restore the memory to the content from this snapshot.

fields.recallWhenPlaceholder: e.g. when the user asks about response style
fields.isCoreDescription: Prioritize this memory during runtime injection and retention.
fields.isBootDescription: Load this memory at conversation startup.

boot.title: Boot Memories
boot.description: Identity anchors and constraints that should load first.

core.title: Core Memories
core.description: High-value memories that should be retained and injected first.

standard.title: Standard Memories
standard.description: General memories used in normal semantic retrieval.
